result.serve_path: read_file() (888-902) correctly serves bundled manifest/sheet via _bundled_pack; but read_thumb() (1318-1341) is the actual 'card preview' path and never checks _bundled_dir at all -- it only looks up pack_id in the network-fetched signed index (_load_stored_index/stored.packs), so any bundled id (never present in that index) raises AvatarUnknown/AvatarNoPreview every time
result.pick_path: start_install()/install() (1023-1057, 1271-1292) gate on _is_bundled() (762-767) and raise AvatarUnknown for any bundled id by design (bundled packs need no install job); select/_run_selector (1152-1160), which calls the real set_selector callback, only ever runs after a job reaches 'installed' -- so if the pick action for a card is wired through the same install(id, select=true) job flow the library tiles use, it 404s immediately for a bundled id and set_selector/PUT-avatar-equivalent never runs, leaving Beacon selected
result.root_cause: Bundled packs load/list correctly (avatar_library.py:769-795) but the preview and pick UI actions reuse the library-pack machinery (read_thumb 1318-1341, start_install/install 1023-1057) that unconditionally rejects or ignores bundled ids (_is_bundled check at 1041-1042/1093-1094, and read_thumb's index-only lookup) -- there is no bundled-aware branch in either, unlike read_file()/available()/pack_tier() which all do check _bundled_pack first
result.second_cause: _pack_row (1450-1473) hardcodes preview=False for every bundled row (line 791) with no alternate signal telling a client 'render straight from sheet.png instead' -- if a client treats preview:false as 'no image available' rather than falling back to GET .../sheet.png, that alone blanks the card even before read_thumb is called

fix: Add a bundled-aware branch to read_thumb (or route the client to GET /avatars/:id/sheet.png for any row with source=='bundled') instead of calling the index-only thumb lookup

Have the pick/select action call the plain PUT /avatar-equivalent path directly for any row already installed (bundled rows are always installed:true), never start_install/install, mirroring how read_file/available/pack_tier already special-case _bundled_pack
Set preview truthfully for bundled rows (e.g. preview=True, since sheet.png is always servable) instead of a hardcoded False, so the client doesn't skip rendering
Add an end-to-end test (HTTP layer, not just AvatarLibrary unit tests) that installs the bundled dir, fetches the card's preview asset, and PUTs a bundled id as the active avatar
